question: In the Notes to Accounts, Contingent Liabilities shall be classified as _______
options: claims against the company not acknowledged as debt
other money for which the company is contingently liable
explanation: Schedule III (Division I) requires contingent liabilities and commitments to be disclosed in Notes. Contingent liabilities are shown under: (a) claims against the company not acknowledged as debt, (b) guarantees, and (c) other money for which the company is contingently liable. So all three apply.

why_not.A: True, but it is only one of the three heads.
why_not.B: True, but it is only one of the three heads.
why_not.C: True, but it is only one of the three heads.

exam_tip: Remember the Schedule III contingent liability heads as: claims, guarantees, others. If all are listed, pick All of the above.
